skill.name: perplexity-search
skill.description: Perform current web and literature searches using Perplexity models through LiteLLM and OpenRouter. The skill provides CLI scripts, setup checks, model guidance, citations, and optional result export for research workflows.
skill.summary: Search current web sources with Perplexity models through OpenRouter.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation-only matches, expected OpenRouter setup references, or benign Markdown syntax. Confirmed risks remain in secret handling, because the setup helper can store and print API keys, and in local output writes that can overwrite user-selected paths. Semantic review also found bundled self-attesting audit text, external query disclosure, and promotional steering to the author platform.

remediation.issue: API key accepted and echoed through the setup helper.
remediation.suggestion: Read the key from a prompt, stdin, or existing environment variable, and never print the full value. Mask any displayed key.

remediation.issue: Setup guidance stores API keys in shell profiles or plaintext .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a secrets manager or runtime environment injection. If .env is supported, require restrictive permissions and clear ignore-file guidance.

remediation.issue: Local file writes can overwrite paths supplied by a user or agent.
remediation.suggestion: Add overwrite confirmation, reject sensitive paths by default, and document that --output and --env-file write local files.

remediation.issue: The package includes self-attesting safety claims in evaluation_result.json.
remediation.suggestion: Remove audit artifacts from the published skill or clearly mark them as non-authoritative historical metadata.

remediation.issue: Search queries are sent to an external API provider.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy notice that confidential, regulated, or proprietary data should not be included in queries.

remediation.issue: Skill instructions promote the author hosted platform during complex workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Remove promotional steering from runtime instructions or move it to clearly labeled marketplace metadata.

content.user_title: Search Current Web Sources with Perplexity
content.value_statement: Research often needs current sources beyond a model cutoff. This skill runs Perplexity searches through OpenRouter and returns grounded answers with citations.
actual_capabilities: Runs Perplexity searches through LiteLLM and OpenRouter.
Supports Sonar Pro, Sonar Pro Search, Sonar, and reasoning models.
Checks whether LiteLLM and OPENROUTER_API_KEY are configured.
Saves successful search results to a user-selected output file.
Includes references for setup, model choice, and query design.
limitations: Requires a valid OpenRouter API key with available credits.
Sends search queries to an external API provider.
Result quality depends on the selected model and available web sources.
The setup helper can store keys in local plaintext files.

use_cases.title: Find Recent Literature
use_cases.description: Search for recent papers, preprints, and clinical evidence with source citations.

use_cases.title: Verify Current Technical Facts
use_cases.description: Check recent documentation, model updates, or implementation guidance before coding.

use_cases.title: Compare Emerging Options
use_cases.description: Gather current evidence for tools, methods, vendors, or scientific approaches.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Current Search
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a current answer with citations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for the latest reliable information on {topic}. Summarize the key points and cite the main sources.

prompt_templates.title: Recent Literature Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: A researcher needs recent scientific sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recent peer-reviewed studies on {topic} from {time_period}. Focus on methods, findings, and limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Model-Guided Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a structured comparison of current options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare {option_a} and {option_b} for {use_case}. Include evidence, tradeoffs, costs, and recent changes.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Research Synthesis
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs deeper source-backed synthesis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the most suitable Perplexity model to analyze {research_question}. Separate consensus, disagreements, evidence quality, and open questions.

output_examples.input: What are the latest developments in CRISPR base editing?
output_examples.output: A concise research summary with recent developments, named techniques, evidence strength, and citations to scientific sources.

output_examples.input: Compare PyTorch and TensorFlow for transformer training in 2026.
output_examples.output: A comparison covering ecosystem maturity, performance evidence, tooling, deployment support, and links to current documentation.

output_examples.input: Find recent clinical trial evidence for intermittent fasting in type 2 diabetes.
output_examples.output: A source-backed clinical summary with trial types, outcomes, population limits, and cautions about medical interpretation.

best_practices: Use precise terms, time ranges, and preferred source types.
Choose cheaper models for simple facts and stronger models for synthesis.
Avoid sending confidential data in search queries.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for simple calculations or local reasoning tasks.
Do not paste private credentials, patient data, or proprietary text into queries.
Do not store API keys in files that are synced or committed.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an OpenRouter API key because searches run through OpenRouter Perplexity models.

faq.question: Does it use a separate Perplexity account?
faq.answer: No. The provided setup uses OpenRouter access to Perplexity models.

faq.question: Can it save results?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI can write successful search results to an output file selected by the user.

faq.question: Which model should I start with?
faq.answer: Start with Sonar Pro for most research. Use Sonar Pro Search for complex synthesis.

faq.question: Are queries private?
faq.answer: Queries are sent to external API providers. Do not include confidential or regulated information.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. Treat results as research assistance and verify important claims against primary sources.
